subject: Renewal: Commit tier re-structure and renewal uplift cap request
messages:
From: Daniel Park <dpark@brightcode.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightcode.com
Date: 2026-02-18T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal planning — commit sizing and uplift cap

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well. Our current Hosted API agreement with Redwood expires 2026-03-31 and we’re starting renewal planning. Two asks from our side before we can sign:

1) Right-sizing: our token consumption has been spiky but trending up. We want options to restructure the commit tiers so we don’t overcommit to peak months.
2) Renewal uplift cap: finance is pushing for a contractual cap on annual renewal price increases (they prefer <= 10% uplift). Can Redwood support a cap tied to our committed spend?

I attached our Q4 usage export for context. Can we set up a short call next week to walk through options (tiered commits, buffer credits, and pricing bands)?

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of ML Platforms
BrightCode Inc.
(Attachment: usage_report_q4.csv)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@brightcode.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — commit sizing and uplift cap

Daniel —

Thanks for the heads up and for the usage export. I’ve reviewed the CSV quickly; you had a few sustained high-traffic weeks but average monthly tokens look ~55M. That gives us room to propose a more flexible commit structure.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick call (30m) to confirm peak drivers and acceptable buffer levels
- I’ll loop in Rachel (pricing) and Markus (contracts) to draft 2 options: 1) Smoothed commit with monthly true-up and 2) Tiered commit + burst pool.
- We’ll include an explicit renewal uplift cap clause to discuss (our standard uplift guidance is usually 12–15% but we can negotiate).

Availability: Thu 2/19 10:00–11:30 or Mon 2/23 14:00–16:00 PT. Which works?

Regards,
Lauren
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Office: (415) 555-0134

From: Daniel Park <dpark@brightcode.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightcode.com, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightcode.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — commit sizing and uplift cap

Thanks — Thu 2/19 10am PT works.

A few clarifying notes ahead of the call:
- Typical baseline: 55M tokens/mo average for Q4, but top percentile weeks hit ~110M
- Burst tolerance: we can accept a burst pool that covers up to 25% of monthly overage, beyond that procurement expects clearer overage pricing
- Renewal uplift: finance will only sign with a hard cap of 10% annual uplift tied to committed spend. If Redwood can offer that, it materially helps the approval.

I’ll upload a short one-pager with our internal preferred structure after the call.

Best,
Daniel
(Attachment: BrightCode_pref_commit_structure.pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@brightcode.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-19T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal options — outputs from our call

Daniel —

Great meeting this morning. Per our conversation, attached is a preliminary proposal and a short note on pricing mechanics. High level options we’ll put into a formal quote:

Option A — Smoothed commit (recommended for volatility):
- Annual committed tokens: 660M (55M * 12)
- Effective per-token price: $0.0009 (5% discount off list)
- Monthly true-up with 60-day settlement; overage billed at per-token list rate beyond burst pool
- Burst pool: 25% of monthly commit can be consumed without overage charge
- Renewal uplift cap: we can commit to a 10% max uplift on per-token list price at renewal if customer keeps >= 80% of prior year commit.

Option B — Tiered commit + burst purchase model:
- Commit tiers (monthly): Bronze 40M, Silver 60M, Gold 90M — choose primary tier at signing
- Per-token price scales with tier (Gold has best rate $0.00085)
- Burst purchase SKU: pre-purchased burst credits at a discounted rate for infrequent peaks
- Renewal uplift: standard guidance 12% but we can negotiate SLA-backed uplift caps for multi-year terms.

Notes on mechanics and risks:
- The 10% hard cap is possible but requires a minimum multi-year commitment and a clause tying the cap to maintained commit levels (helps us plan capacity).
- Legal will want clean language on how the cap is computed (percentage on list price vs. effective price). Markus will draft the specific clause.

Attached: Renewal_Quote_BRIC-2026.xlsx (draft pricing), and a sample SOW redline for typical language.

Next actions:
1) Rachel to convert Option A into a formal quote and circulate redline SOW.
2) You to confirm target commit band and whether BrightCode is open to a 2-year term for the uplift cap.
3) Meet for final sign-off wk of 2/23 if possible.

Thanks,
Lauren
(Attachments: Renewal_Quote_BRIC-2026.xlsx, BrightCode_SOW_v3_redline.pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@brightcode.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-23T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: Formal quote: BrightCode renewal (Option A recommended)

Daniel —

Attaching the formal quote and an SOW with the proposed renewal uplift clause included. Summary:
- Term: 24 months (preferred for uplift cap)
- Year 1 commit: 660M tokens (smoothing) -> monthly commit of 55M
- Effective list price year 1: $0.00100/token; committed price (with discount) $0.00095/token (5% off list)
- Burst pool: 25% of monthly commit included; overage after burst billed at list
- Renewal uplift clause: max 10% increase on list price at renewal, provided BrightCode retains >= 80% of preceding 12-month committed spend.
- Early termination: standard 90-day notice with pro-rated true-up.

Please review the attached SOW redline (BrightCode_SOW_v3_redline.pdf). Key ask from legal on our side: the uplift cap has to reference list price indexing and exclude any third-party infra pass-through costs.

If this aligns, can Procurement confirm signature authority and whether DocuSign is preferred? We can route the finalized quote & SOW today.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Senior Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: BrightCode_SOW_v3_redline.pdf, Renewal_Quote_BRIC-2026.xlsx)

From: Daniel Park <dpark@brightcode.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightcode.com, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightcode.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Formal quote: BrightCode renewal (Option A recommended)

Rachel / Lauren —

Thanks for the clear proposal and for accommodating the uplift cap. Procurement reviewed the SOW and a couple quick points before we can route for signature:

1) Can Redwood accept the 10% uplift cap as a cap on the per-token list price (not effective price)? We prefer list price indexing for simplicity.
2) We’re willing to commit to the 24-month term at the 660M annual commit provided the renewal uplift cap is hard-capped at 10% and the >=80% retention condition is expressed as a rolling 12-month committed spend measurement.
3) One ask from operations: include a quarterly usage review checkpoint with Redwood to discuss bursting trends and potential re-tiering (operational help to avoid surprise overages).

If you can confirm these three items, Procurement will prepare to sign via DocuSign by EOD Wed 3/3.

Best,
Daniel Park
Head of ML Platforms
BrightCode Inc.
(Procurement: procurement@brightcode.com)
